Plans for development of tourism
*181. SHRI T.T.V. DHINAKARAN:
Will the Minister of TOURISM be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that perspective
plans of 20 years for developing tourism in
the States have been prepared.
(b) if so, the details and the target of
these plans; and
(c) the details of plans envisaged in
respect of Tamil Nadu?
Competition in market place
*182. SHRI SANTOSH
BAGRODIA:
SHRI HARISH RAWAT:
Will the Minister of COMPANY
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government considers
promoting competition a serious policy
issue as envisaged in the National Common
Minimum Programme and other statements
made from time to time by Government;
and
(b) what policy initiatives Government
have taken to ensure competition in the
market place?
Support and suggestions from World
Bank on water related issues
*183. SHRI B.K. HARIPRASAD: Will
the Minister of WATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the World Bank has
enhanced the quantum of its loan for
water-related sectors in India from $200
million a year to $800 million a year for
four years;
(b) what are the pre-conditions set
forth by the Bank for extending this loan
package;
(c) whether the World Bank report on
India's performance on water-related
issues, mentions of poor management and
predicts a turbulent future, devoid of
minimum requirement of water to sustain
its economy; and
(d) whether the Bank has recommended
construction of mega dams in the country
to enhance its water storage capacity from
the 30 days of rainfall to 900 days as is
done in major river basins in arid areas of
developed countries?

58
Tax on advertisement space
*184. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have issued a clarification, bringing into the
tax net, the advertisement space sold to
advertisers;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
publishers have to pay 10.2 per cent tax to
Government due to this move; and
(c) if so, what are the reasons for taking
this step which affects the readers?
New refinery near Bina
*185. SHRIMATI SUKHBUNS
KAUR: Will the Minister of
PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Bharat Petroleum
Corporation Ltd. is contemplating a joint
venture for setting up a new refinery in
Bina in Madhya Pradesh;
(b) if so, the details of the joint venture;
(c) whether a detailed design and
feasibility report for the same has also been
prepared, if so, the estimated cost and
capacity of the projected refinery; and
(d) the progress made so far in this
regard?
Bio-diesel policy
†*186. DR. MURLI MANOHAR
JOSHI:
SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that bio-diesel
can be prepared from Ratan Jot;
(b) if so, whether it has been confirmed
officially;
(c) whether it is also a fact that
Government have not been able to decide
any policy regarding bio-diesel so far; and
(d) if so, the details in this regard
and by when, the policy is likely to be
decided?
Shutdown by LPG producing plants
*187. SHRI DIPANKAR
MUKHERJEE:
SHRI CHITTABRATA
MAJUMDAR:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of unforeseen shutdowns
in LPG producing plants in public and
private sector refineries during last six
months, month-wise;
(b) whether a planned shutdown for 45
days was resorted to by Jamnagar Refinery
from 4th October, 2005;
(c) if so, its impact on LPG shortage in
the country in domestic sector; and
(d) the reason, for permitting such
planned shutdown during peak demand in
festive season?
Development of places to attract
foreign tourists
†*188. SHRIMATI PREMA
CARIAPPA:
SHRI MOTILAL VORA:
Will the Minister of TOURISM be
pleased to state:
(a) the year-wise increase in the number

last three years;
(b) whether Government are aware that
still there are many places left where
development would automatically attract
the tourist and people will get jobs;

such places;
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor; and
(e) the concrete arrangements made by
Government to avoid any untoward
incident with the foreign or the Indian
tourists?
